documentCompare.title: Document Compare Usage Guide
documentCompare.description: Compare Word and Hangul (HWP) documents before and after revisions to check for changes in text, tables, and formatting.

blocks.title: Use Cases
items: Finding changes in a revised report
Comparing multiple drafts against the original
Checking for missing or added document content.

blocks.title: How to Use
items: Add the pre-revision and post-revision files respectively.
Check the file mapping and order for comparison.
Run the comparison.
Review the original and revised versions along with the list of changes on the result screen.
Save the desired results.

blocks.title: Results and Precautions
paragraphs: Read the original text alongside the change indicators to verify if it represents an actual meaning change. Indicators might appear due to internal structure or formatting differences. Automated handling may be difficult if similar types of content repeat.

blocks.title: Can I compare a Word document with an HWP file?
paragraphs: When revising reports or notices multiple times, it is easy to miss what has changed. Document Compare highlights the differences in text, tables, and formatting between two versions to help you locate areas for review. Connect Word documents with Word documents, and Hangul documents with Hangul documents.

Select Web Comparison to read the changed parts immediately, or Excel Report to organize a review list. If both files are DOCX, you can also generate a Track Changes result to view in Word. Because change indicators do not judge the business significance of the document, please read them alongside the original text.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: When one document changes a submission date and a department-table cell, review both the body-text differences and the table differences on the result screen. Check every reported change against the original documents before using the comparison result.

faq_0.q: Can I use both Word and Hangul files?
faq_0.a: You can select and compare supported Word and Hangul files. Check the support guide in the selection area for openable formats and file-specific limitations.

faq_1.q: Can I compare DOC with DOCX?
faq_1.a: Yes. Both belong to the Word family, so either order is supported.

faq_2.q: Can I compare DOCX with HWP?
faq_2.a: No. The pair is rejected before analysis. Pair Word files together and HWP files together.

faq_3.q: Does tracked Word output work for DOC?
faq_3.a: No. It is limited to pairs where both files are DOCX.

new_faq_4.q: Can the exact same text be marked as a change?
new_faq_4.a: Formatting or internal document structure might have changed. Read the marked section along with the original and check if it's a comparison that includes formatting changes.

new_faq_5.q: Do I have to read every single difference?
new_faq_5.a: First, look at the list of additions, deletions, and modifications, and prioritize important details like dates, amounts, and subjects. Also check if you have selected table comparison and other document areas.

/tools/document-compare/results/:pairNum.title: Reading change marks alongside the original text
paragraphs: Select a change from the list to view the corresponding location in both the original and revised documents simultaneously. Prioritize important details such as dates, amounts, and subjects. Manually review areas where the connection is ambiguous or where the table or formatting structure has changed. If you need a review record, save the results.

security.title: Password Generator Guide
security.description: Created using the secure random number function provided by the operating system, and passwords are not sent to the server.

blocks.title: Long and Unique
paragraphs: It is recommended to use different passwords of at least 16 characters for each site and store them in a password manager.

blocks.title: Strength Score
paragraphs: Calculated based on estimated guess attempts and patterns like common words, repetitions, and sequential characters. It does not check for leaks or the multi-factor authentication status of the account.

blocks.title: Estimated Crack Time
paragraphs: A comparative value assuming a stored password hash is leaked and an attacker can attempt 10 billion guesses per second. Actual time varies greatly depending on the site's storage method and security settings.

blocks.title: Is the estimated crack time a guaranteed measure of security?
paragraphs: Generate a password after checking the length and character types allowed by the site you intend to use. Keep the generated value separate from passwords you reuse elsewhere, and check if it is successfully registered on the intended site.

The strength score and estimated crack time are comparative values based on set assumptions. It does not mean the result has been scanned to see if the account was leaked, if login attempts are restricted, or if other protection measures are in place. Do not write the actual passwords you use in bug reports or examples.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: It is recommended not to test with passwords you actually use for your accounts. Adjust the length and allowed character options to see how secure patterns are generated.

faq_0.q: Are the generated passwords saved?
faq_0.a: No. They disappear once you leave the current screen.

faq_1.q: Does the estimated crack time mean actual security time?
faq_1.a: No. It is a hypothetical value to compare the strength between passwords. Actual attack conditions vary based on login attempt limits, password storage methods, and multi-factor authentication.

faq_2.a: Since other apps can access the clipboard, it is recommended to copy and overwrite it with something else after use.

new_faq_3.q: Does a high score mean it's confirmed not to be leaked?
new_faq_3.a: No. It is the result of analyzing the pattern of the entered string. It is not a feature that queries leaked accounts or databases.

new_faq_4.q: Can I see the generated password again if I close the page?
new_faq_4.a: This tool does not store generation history. Before closing the page, save the chosen value in a secure storage method that you use.

formatter.title: Formatter Usage Guide
formatter.description: Entered text is processed only in the browser's separate workspace.

blocks.title: Error Checking
paragraphs: Indentation makes the JSON structure easier to read. Spaces inside quotes are part of the value and should be distinguished from formatting spaces. Note that a successful syntax check or formatting does not guarantee that the code will execute safely. Always verify the safety by testing.

blocks.title: Minify to One Line
paragraphs: Maintains text and spaces inside quotes, and only reduces unnecessary spaces and line breaks that are not required for the data structure.

blocks.title: Does formatting SQL also check for execution errors?
paragraphs: It breaks down long strings of JSON, SQL, or XML with line breaks and indentation to make them easier to read. If an error is displayed, check the quotes, brackets, or delimiters at that location. It does not arbitrarily change invalid values to make them look like normal data.

SQL formatting does not connect to a database. Even if it is nicely formatted, it does not confirm whether the actual tables/columns exist or if the command is safe to execute. Do not share business connection details or authentication keys as examples.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: Indentation makes JSON structures easier to read. Spaces within quotes are part of the value and should be distinguished from formatting spaces. A successful format or syntax check does not guarantee safe execution. If you need to execute the code, review it in a separate test environment after verifying permissions and impact.

faq_0.q: Does it execute SQL?
faq_0.a: No. It only formats text without a database connection.

faq_1.q: Does it auto-recover invalid JSON?
faq_1.a: To prevent data alteration, it shows the error without arbitrarily recovering it.

new_faq_2.q: Does a well-formatted SQL statement mean it's safe to execute?
new_faq_2.a: No. This tool only organizes text layout. The execution results and the risk of data modification must be evaluated separately in the actual database environment you use.

new_faq_3.q: Does it automatically fix JSON errors?
new_faq_3.a: It points out errors without arbitrarily changing the data. Check the structure of the original, modify it, and format it again.

converter.title: Table Data Conversion Guide
converter.description: Files and text are processed in the browser's separate workspace.

blocks.title: CSV
paragraphs: Uses the first row as column names, and interprets cells with quotes, commas, and line breaks using standard CSV quote rules.

blocks.title: JSON / HTML
paragraphs: This is a basic structural example using string values. For number or date formats included in your files, run the converter and check the preview to see how they are inferred and displayed.

blocks.title: How are column names determined when converting JSON to CSV?
paragraphs: Use this to turn a CSV saved in Excel into JSON to pass to a program, or to create an HTML table to embed in a webpage. This tool does not rewrite the table's content; it simply converts the same data into a different display format.

Ensure that the column names in the first row, like 'Name' or 'Quantity', are clear. Since some cells might contain commas or line breaks, it is better to check the number of rows/columns and cell contents in the conversion result rather than simply splitting the CSV by commas in Notepad.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: In this example, values are shown as strings. Check the converted output before using it in another program.

faq_0.q: Are large CSV files supported?
faq_0.a: Processed as a separate task within the browser's memory limit. Hundreds of thousands of rows may take time depending on file size and device memory.

faq_1.q: Are scripts inside HTML executed?
faq_1.a: No. It only extracts text from table cells and does not insert or execute the input HTML on the screen.

new_faq_2.q: Are Excel's colors and formulas transferred too?
new_faq_2.a: This is a data conversion between CSV, JSON, and HTML tables. Do not use it as a tool to transfer the cell formatting, formulas, or charts of an Excel workbook exactly as they are.

new_faq_3.q: What should I check if Korean characters are garbled?
new_faq_3.a: Check the character encoding settings used to read the CSV and how the original file was saved. First, look at the preview before conversion to see if the Korean characters and delimiters are read correctly.

textMerger.title: Text Merger Usage Guide
textMerger.description: Gathers manually entered text and TXT files into one list and merges them into a single text.

blocks.title: Use Cases
items: Consolidating multiple notes into one file
Inserting guide sentences between TXT files
Connecting separated lists in a specific order.

blocks.title: How to Use
items: Add manual input or TXT files.
Determine the order of the cards.
Choose the line break, space, or separator character to insert between each text.
Check the merged result and copy it or save it as a TXT file.

blocks.title: Can I insert custom titles between the merged TXT files?
paragraphs: Put meeting notes, various TXT files, and custom-written sentences into the same list and set their order. Adding a blank line between each card separates paragraphs, and specifying a custom delimiter makes the boundaries of the data easy to recognize.

Since this task gathers content without modifying it, it does not automatically summarize the conclusions of different documents or combine sentences with the same meaning. Check the final result to ensure titles are not duplicated and that the end of one sentence doesn't stick directly to the start of the next.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: Review the merged list on the right to ensure the order and content are correct before downloading.

faq_0.q: Can I insert manually written sentences between files?
faq_0.a: Yes. You can place manual input cards and TXT file cards in any desired order within the same list.

faq_1.q: Can pasted text be placed between TXT files?
faq_1.a: Yes. Pasted text and TXT files share one card list and can be reordered freely by dragging or with the up and down buttons.

faq_2.q: Are pasted text or TXT files sent to a server?
faq_2.a: No. Content is read and merged only in the current browser and is not kept on a server or in browser storage.

faq_3.q: Does editing loaded TXT content change the original file?
faq_3.a: No. Only the card and merged result change. The original TXT file remains untouched.

new_faq_4.q: There are too many blank lines between files.
new_faq_4.a: Check if the line breaks at the end of the original text and the selected delimiter were inserted together. Apply the options to trim leading/trailing spaces and exclude empty text only when necessary.

new_faq_5.q: Will it naturally rewrite sentences to connect them?
new_faq_5.a: No. It connects the entered text using the specified order and delimiters. You must manually check the phrasing and content by looking at the results.

textTools.title: Text Tools Usage Guide
textTools.description: Cleans up spaces, line breaks, and duplicate lines in pasted text according to the selected method.

blocks.title: Use Cases
items: When copied text has many unnecessary line breaks
Removing duplicate lines from a list
Standardizing the formatting of English names.

blocks.title: How to Use
items: Paste the original text.
Choose the necessary actions, such as space cleanup or line break merging.
Compare the result with the original text.
Copy and use the result.

blocks.title: Is it okay to remove line breaks within a list?
paragraphs: If sentences copied from a PDF are broken at every line, you can use Merge Line Breaks. On the other hand, removing all line breaks from data where each line is an item, like a contact list, will destroy the boundaries between items.

Removing duplicate lines also requires caution if the same product name refers to different transactions. Apply one necessary task, compare the original with the result, and ensure the list count and spacing are as intended.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: A line break in the middle of a sentence can be merged into a space, while a list of city names should keep each item on its own line. Preview part of the result first and choose the method that fits sentences or lists.

faq_0.q: Does it also fix the content or meaning of the text?
faq_0.a: Space and line cleanup applies selected rules. It is not a feature that understands the meaning and rewrites sentences.

new_faq_1.q: Does it also find duplicate sentences with the same meaning?
new_faq_1.a: This is not a tool for comparing the meaning of sentences. It applies fixed text rules, so you must manually judge whether sentences with different expressions have the same meaning.

new_faq_2.q: What is Change English Case used for?
new_faq_2.a: It is used to format multiple words into conventions like camelCase or snake_case. Before applying it to people's names or document titles, verify the result to ensure it is the desired formatting.

work.title: Working Day Calculation Criteria
work.description: Public holiday information and annual leave results are reference values for schedule planning.

blocks.title: Public Holidays
paragraphs: Calculates solar public holidays, Seollal, Chuseok, Buddha's Birthday, and substitute holidays. Fixed election days and temporary holidays are also reflected in the yearly list. Please manually add company holidays.

blocks.title: Annual Leave
paragraphs: Applies the basic accrual structure under the Labor Standards Act, but the actual granted days may vary depending on the company's fiscal year operation and time-and-attendance settlement methods.

blocks.title: How do I include company-specific holidays in the business day calculation?
paragraphs: Distinguish between the total days between two dates on a calendar and the number of business days excluding weekends and public holidays. Days off specific to the company, like a founding anniversary or departmental holiday, must be added manually as custom holidays.

Leave calculations are reference results based on the entered reference date and calculation method. Generated leave is different from the remaining leave after usage, so always verify the actual remaining days against the company's usage records. It's also best to check if newly designated holidays are reflected before calculating.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: Adding a company holiday as a custom holiday changes the business-day count even for the same date range. Add company-specific days off manually and distinguish them from official public holidays when checking the result.

faq_0.q: Are temporary holidays automatically reflected?
faq_0.a: Confirmed public holidays reflected in the yearly list are automatically calculated. If recent government announcements are not yet reflected, or if it's a company-specific day off, please add it manually.

faq_1.q: Is the final leave settlement upon resignation identical?
faq_1.a: No. Resignation settlements require checking both the accrued leave based on the joining date and the number of days used at the company.

new_faq_2.q: The results for the hire date basis and fiscal year basis are different.
new_faq_2.a: This is because the reference periods used to group and calculate leave are different. Confirm the standard your company uses first, and check the generation, usage, and settlement histories separately.

new_faq_3.q: Are the displayed leave days the ones I have left?
new_faq_3.a: The reference value calculated for generation structure is different from the remaining balance after usage. Verify with your actual usage history and company settlement standards.

payroll.title: Simple Payroll Calculator Guide
payroll.description: Does not replace actual payslips and statutory settlements.

blocks.title: Net Pay
paragraphs: Estimates social insurance and monthly income tax based on the monthly taxable salary (excluding non-taxable allowances like meals) and the number of dependents. It may vary depending on the company's reported standard monthly income, non-taxable items, and withholding rates.

blocks.title: Severance Pay
paragraphs: Reflects the wages of the 3 months before retirement and 3/12 of the recent year's bonuses and annual leave allowances. The total number of days for 3 months includes calendar dates including holidays. Separate verification is needed if the calculated average wage is lower than the ordinary wage.

blocks.title: Why is the estimated amount different from my actual payslip?
paragraphs: Monthly salary, taxable income, and non-taxable allowances might not be the same values. Read the guide for each input field, enter the appropriate amounts, and then review the resulting insurance and tax items separately.

These results are simplified calculations based on input conditions. They may differ from your actual pay slip due to the company's reported amounts, applied standards, actual attendance, and settlement methods. If the difference is significant, do not just look at the calculation result; check the input amounts, dependents, base date, and each deduction item on your slip together.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: Display the actual applied year / update date / input assumptions / excluded items under "Standards used for calculation" below the results. Do not hardcode legal figures and tax rates in the manuscript; fetch them from verified calculation data.

faq_0.q: Is the entered salary saved?
faq_0.a: No. All values are calculated only in the current screen state and browser memory.

faq_1.q: Can I use it for tax reporting?
faq_1.a: No. It is an estimated value for reference, and actual withholding and severance pay should be verified with the company's payroll manager or relevant authorities.

new_faq_2.q: Is the calculation wrong if it differs slightly from my pay slip?
new_faq_2.a: First, check if the entered salary base and the taxable/non-taxable/deduction items on the actual slip match. This tool's simplified calculation cannot reflect the reporting and settlement differences of every company.

new_faq_3.q: Can I use these results as the basis for final company settlement?
new_faq_3.a: These are reference values for preliminary checking. Actual payroll and severance settlements must be processed by checking work records and applied standards.

imagePrivacy.title: Photo Metadata Remover Guide
imagePrivacy.description: Check and remove hidden details like capture location, device, and time embedded inside the file, rather than the visible content of the photo.

blocks.title: Use it when
items: Checking capture location details before sharing a photo publicly.
You need a copy that doesn't include the camera device or capture time.

blocks.title: How to use
items: Choose JPG, PNG, or WebP photos.
Press 'Inspect and remove metadata'.
Review the detected capture details and save the cleaned photo.
Check the orientation and appearance of the saved photo.

blocks.title: Does removing metadata also erase addresses visible in the photo?
paragraphs: Even if an address is not visible in the photo, shooting locations and device information may be stored inside the file. This tool checks the shooting data of JPG, PNG, and WebP files and creates a copy with the information cleaned up. HEIC and HEIF are not currently supported.

Faces, names, and addresses directly captured in the photo are not obscured by this process. Handle such content with image editing or personal info redaction. After saving the new photo, check not only the shooting data but also the orientation, color, and quality, and avoid confusing the copy with the original when sharing.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: You can inspect and remove hidden metadata such as GPS coordinates and device-owner information. Names, addresses, or numbers visibly shown in the picture are not hidden metadata and require separate image editing.

faq_0.q: Which photo formats are supported?
faq_0.a: JPG, PNG and WebP are supported; HEIC and HEIF are not. Files with either a .jpg or .jpeg extension are accepted. Convert HEIC or HEIF photos to a supported format before selecting them.

faq_1.q: Which photo formats are supported?
faq_1.a: JPG, PNG and WebP are supported; HEIC and HEIF are not. Both .jpg and .jpeg extensions are accepted.

new_faq_2.q: Can the orientation or size of the photo change after removal?
new_faq_2.a: You must re-verify the display orientation and file size while creating the new copy. Open the saved photo to check if it looks as desired, and keep the original separately.

new_faq_3.q: If it says there is no shooting data, does it mean the photo has no personal information?
new_faq_3.a: Not at all. Visible faces, addresses, and license plates are independent of shooting data. You must manually check the photo itself as well.

qr.title: QR Code Usage Guide
qr.description: Generated content, camera frames, and scanned images are not sent to external servers.

blocks.title: Center Logo
paragraphs: Uses a high error correction level and adds a white margin behind the logo. If the logo is too complex, the recognition rate may drop on some cameras.

blocks.title: Real-time Camera
paragraphs: Prioritizes the rear camera after obtaining user permission over a secure connection (HTTPS). When a QR is found, it immediately stops the camera and analysis operations.

blocks.title: Photo Scan
paragraphs: Large images are downscaled to a maximum of 2200px within the browser, and it also attempts to find the QR by inverting bright and dark colors.

blocks.title: How do I find the link from a QR code inside a photo?
paragraphs: Enter the link or sentence to embed in the QR and check the preview. If there's a typo in the link, the QR will lead to the wrong address even if generated successfully. After changing the logo and color, it's best to rescan it at the actual size and against the intended background.

The reading feature shows the content inside the QR; it does not judge the safety of the linked site. Verify the address and destination before opening the link. For QRs to be printed, please check them with a printed sample on paper as well.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: Review sequence: Check spelling of input address → Generate PNG → Scan with phone → Scan at actual print size and background. Retain the bulk auto-redecoding validation but do not expand it to a guarantee of scanning in all environments.

faq_0.q: Does it also check the safety of the QR URL?
faq_0.a: No. It merely displays the QR data and does not guarantee the safety of the linked site.

faq_1.q: When is the camera permission used?
faq_1.a: Permission is requested only when the scan via camera button is pressed. The camera track is immediately stopped upon scan completion, turning off the camera, switching tabs, or closing the page.

faq_2.q: Which table files can create QR codes in bulk?
faq_2.a: It reads XLSX, XLSM, XLS, XLSB, SpreadsheetML XLS and CSV files, then creates one QR code for every data row in the selected sheet.

faq_3.q: Are generated QR codes checked for readability?
faq_3.a: Yes. The final PNG, including a logo or transparent background, is decoded again and accepted only when it exactly matches the original payload.

faq_4.q: Are tables or QR results uploaded to a server?
faq_4.a: No. Table reading, QR creation, ZIP, label PDF and report generation happen in the current browser without modifying the source file.

new_faq_5.q: Can I change the address inside the QR after making it?
new_faq_5.a: The generated image contains the content from when it was made. If the content changes, you must create and replace it with a new QR image. Do not instruct that this tool provides redirection management features for linked servers.

new_faq_6.q: It scans well on the screen, but poorly on the printout.
new_faq_6.a: Check if it was printed too small, or if margins, backgrounds, or logos overlap with the code. Print a sample at the actual intended size and scan it multiple times.

/tools/qr-studio/bulk.title: How do I turn each row in an Excel list into a separate QR code?
paragraphs: Check the address/text and the save name for each row, then select which column to include in the QR content. Cleaning up empty values, duplicate file names, and typos first will reduce the need to regenerate results. For printable labels, print a single sample first to check the content, margins, and size.

timezone.title: World Time Zone Map Usage Guide
timezone.description: The map and city coordinates are included in the site, and selection information is not transmitted outside the browser.

blocks.title: Map and City Selection
paragraphs: You can select up to 6 cities using pins or city search. After zooming in, drag the map to check pins in dense areas.

blocks.title: Daylight Saving Time (DST)
paragraphs: Cities like New York, London, and Sydney have different transition dates. The time difference with UTC is calculated using the International standard city time zone (IANA) rules for the selected date.

blocks.title: Meeting Recommendations
paragraphs: Displays only the intervals (in 30-minute increments) where all selected cities are within their local 09:00~18:00.

blocks.title: Does the time difference between New York and Seoul change depending on the meeting date?
paragraphs: When scheduling an overseas meeting, select the date along with the cities. Areas using Daylight Saving Time may have changing time differences depending on the season, and evening in one region might be the next morning in another.

When meeting options appear, read the local dates and times for each city together. The recommended slots are the results of comparing preset local business hours on the screen, and do not account for the actual work schedules of the companies involved or national public holidays.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: Example sentence format: "Seoul: [Month] [Day] [Time] / Other City: [Month] [Day] [Time]". Use actual selection results instead of fixed time difference numbers, and separately indicate cities with different dates.

faq_0.q: Does it connect to an external map server while using the map?
faq_0.a: No. The Natural Earth-based world map and city coordinates are distributed together as static assets.

faq_1.q: Can I tap anywhere on the map to find a time zone?
faq_1.a: No. Currently, you can only select major city pins registered with official time zone information and search results.

faq_2.a: This tool only compares time differences and local business hours, and does not reflect country-specific public holidays.

new_faq_3.q: Is it an error if no overlapping times appear?
new_faq_3.a: The designated business hours may not simultaneously overlap across all selected cities. Check the number of cities or the meeting date, and negotiate available times separately with the participants.

new_faq_4.q: Are public holidays also recommended as business hours?
new_faq_4.a: This tool compares time differences and local business hours, but does not reflect national public holidays. Check the holiday status of each region before confirming the meeting.

excel.title: Excel Merger Usage Guide
excel.description: Gathers multiple Excel files by sheet, or concatenates tables downwards or sideways.

blocks.title: Use Cases
items: Consolidating departmental data into one file
Merging monthly lists vertically
Attaching divided tables in a specific direction.

blocks.title: What to Prepare
paragraphs: Excel or CSV files to merge and the sheets to include.

blocks.title: How to Use
items: Add files and select the sheets to merge.
Check the order of files and sheets that will be in the result.
Choose a merging method. 'By Sheet' collects sheets, 'Vertical' appends downwards, and 'Horizontal' appends sideways.
Review options to maintain formulas and formatting, and the support guide on the screen, before merging.
Open the result and check if the number of sheets, rows, and column positions are as expected.

blocks.title: Results and Precautions
paragraphs: Creates a new XLSX file. Features beyond macros and the supported range may not be maintained, so keep the original. Do not confuse horizontal merging with features that automatically link data based on criteria like customer ID.

blocks.title: What is the difference between merging into one file and appending to one sheet?
paragraphs: If you want to gather data by department into one file but view each table separately, choose merge by sheet. To stack lists with the same columns vertically, use vertical merge. To combine tables with the same row order side-by-side, use horizontal merge.

Horizontal merge is not a feature for looking up customer numbers or employee IDs to link the same person. If the row order of the two tables differs, incorrect values may be placed side-by-side, so always check the data order first. After saving the result, check the number of sheets, the first and last rows, and a few key formulas.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: Use merge by sheet to keep January and February data on separate tabs, or vertical merge to append transactions with the same columns. Horizontal merge assumes matching row order; check row alignment and repeated header rows in the saved result.

faq_0.q: Can XLSX formulas and formatting be preserved independently?
faq_0.a: Yes. Formula and formatting preservation are separate XLSX switches on the current screen and require no additional files.

faq_1.q: Can XLS formulas and formatting be preserved independently?
faq_1.a: Yes. Formula and formatting preservation are separate switches, and either one opens the higher-fidelity conversion workspace.

faq_2.q: Does preservation retain every XLS feature perfectly?
faq_2.a: It prioritizes formulas and common cell formatting, but charts, external links, macros and some advanced objects can differ. Verify important output in Excel.

new_faq_3.q: Should I use merge or compare?
new_faq_3.a: Choose merge to combine multiple datasets into one file, and Excel Compare to find what has changed between two datasets.

new_faq_4.q: What should I check in the merged result?
new_faq_4.a: First, check the order of files and sheets, repeated column header rows, missing rows, and the references and displayed values of formulas. Keep the original files stored separately until result verification is complete.

/tools/excel-merger/xls-preserve.title: Features to preserve and results to verify
paragraphs: This is the processing screen required to maintain XLS formulas and formatting. Preparation time may take longer than standard pages. Verify the formulas and cell displays of the preserved results in your original software. This feature does not guarantee that macros, charts, or external links will remain completely identical.

audio.title: Audio Waveform Editing Guide
audio.description: Selected audio and editing data are not transmitted to an external server and are processed only within the current browser.

blocks.title: Waveform Selection
paragraphs: Dragging the waveform creates a selection area. You can move the entire area, adjust the handles on both sides, and specify values down to 1ms by entering the start and end seconds.

blocks.title: Sample-level Editing
paragraphs: Mute changes selected samples to 0, and Cut and Delete pull trailing samples forward. Paste inserts the memory clip at the current playback position.

blocks.title: Voice Effects for Selected Section
paragraphs: Low Pitch, High Pitch, and Child Voice change the pitch while maintaining the original length, and Robot rapidly modulates the amplitude. You can preview the selected section before applying, and short crossfades are added at the boundaries.

blocks.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
paragraphs: Outside input fields, use Space to Play/Pause, and Ctrl+Z or Cmd+Z (on macOS) to Undo. Ctrl+Shift+Z, Cmd+Shift+Z, Ctrl+Y, or Cmd+Y are for Redo.

blocks.title: Undo and Memory
paragraphs: Uncompressed voice samples (PCM) for editing are kept per channel. The Undo history is automatically limited to a maximum of 12 steps and an approx. 256MB limit depending on file size, and is cleared when a new file is opened.

blocks.title: WAV and MP3
paragraphs: WAV creates highly compatible 16-bit uncompressed audio quickly. Audio processing features needed for MP3 saving and pitch effects are prepared on first use, reducing preparation time on the same editing screen.

blocks.title: Browser File Support
paragraphs: MP3 and WAV can be opened in general modern browsers. M4A, AAC, and OGG can be edited when the operating system and browser support the audio compression method in the file.

blocks.title: What is the difference in output length between deleting and muting audio?
paragraphs: Drag to select the required section on the waveform and play it first. Delete/Cut removes the selected section and pulls the remaining audio forward. Mute leaves the length of the section intact and only silences that part.

If it's a recording that needs to match a video's length, the difference between mute and delete is crucial. Paste inserts audio at the playback position, so check your cursor location. Before saving, listen to the areas before and after the editing boundaries to ensure they don't cut off awkwardly.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: Deleting a selected section shortens the recording, while muting it keeps the total duration. Before saving, confirm which action applies to the selection and listen around both edit boundaries.

faq_0.q: Is audio uploaded to the server?
faq_0.a: No. Opening files, editing samples, waveform previews, and resulting conversions are executed solely in the current browser.

faq_1.q: Do low pitch and high pitch change gender?
faq_1.a: No. It is an effect that changes only the pitch and timbre of the selected section without determining or changing a person's gender.

faq_2.a: It gets inserted at the current time of the playback position, set by clicking or playing the waveform.

faq_3.q: Why do long files use a lot of memory?
faq_3.a: Because even compressed audio must be decompressed into uncompressed samples per channel for editing, and waveform playback data and Undo states are also kept.

faq_4.a: It might be possible if the encoder was cached previously. For your first visit in a completely offline state, please use WAV.

faq_5.q: Do editing results overwrite the original?
faq_5.a: No. The original file is not modified, and you download a new WAV or MP3 file.

faq_6.q: Can I pick an audio section and save it?
faq_6.a: Yes. Open the file, select the section, and save only that part.

faq_7.q: Does anything process automatically on open?

new_faq_8.q: Does a small waveform mean the sound is quiet?
new_faq_8.a: The waveform helps you locate positions and sections, but it doesn't tell you about the listening environment. Play the selected section yourself to judge.

new_faq_9.q: How do I make sure my edits don't disappear?
new_faq_9.a: Save the required results as WAV or MP3. Opening a new file clears the existing edit history and clipboard, so verify your results before switching to another file.

/tools/audio-studio/trim.title: How do I trim and save by cutting out the unwanted parts at the beginning and end of a recording?
paragraphs: After selecting a section on the waveform, check whether the applied action will keep, delete, or mute the selected part. Test with a short segment first and listen to the audio before and after the boundary. Save the desired result before opening the next file.

image.title: Browser Image Editing Guide
image.description: Original images and editing results are not uploaded to external processing servers.

blocks.title: Integrated Image Editing
paragraphs: Open a photo or start with a blank canvas to use adjustments, drawing, text, shapes, and searchable stickers within one work history. You can change the entire content or canvas size separately and specify the export pixel size. Zoom in with the mouse wheel, drag while pressing Space to move, and use two fingers to zoom and move on mobile.

blocks.title: Area Mosaic / Blur
paragraphs: You can drag areas to obscure in the photo and adjust the effect intensity. The effect applies based on the original photo, so if areas overlap, the last effect is visible. It does not apply to separately drawn lines or text. For sensitive information, a strong mosaic is recommended over a low-intensity blur. Before downloading, zoom in to check the obscured state.

blocks.title: Batch Processing
paragraphs: Add multiple files and clipboard images to apply resizing and watermarks, and bundle them into a ZIP.

blocks.title: Collage and GIF
paragraphs: Provides downscaled previews equal to the actual output calculation, and GIFs may have simplified color changes due to the 256-color limit.

blocks.title: What is the difference between image size and canvas size?
paragraphs: Changing the horizontal and vertical pixels alters the size of the image itself, while changing the canvas size alters the workspace around the photo. Decide first whether you want to send a smaller photo or add margins to fit a specific ratio.

To remove part of the content, use crop; to blur sensitive areas, use region effects; to insert text or a logo, select the corresponding editing tool. After saving, check the resulting image again to ensure it is the desired size and that no parts meant to be hidden or cropped are left.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: Shrinking a 1600px photo to 800px changes the image itself, while adding margins to a square canvas keeps the photo and changes its surroundings. This tool supports cropping and region effects, but it does not automatically crop subjects or remove backgrounds.

faq_0.q: Are images sent to the server?
faq_0.a: No. They are processed only within the current browser.

faq_1.q: Is the original file changed?
faq_1.a: No. All results are downloaded as new files.

faq_2.q: Can I recover contents obscured by mosaic or blur?
faq_2.a: For downloaded PNG, JPG, or WebP files, the effects are embedded into the original photo pixels, leaving no previous pixels of the obscured areas. However, during the editing session before downloading, you can revert to the pre-effect state using Undo.

faq_3.a: Inputs are JPG, PNG, and WebP; HEIC and HEIF are not supported. Outputs are PNG, JPG, WebP, and GIF.

faq_4.q: Can I keep the transparent background?
faq_4.a: PNG and WebP maintain transparency, whereas JPG treats it as white.

faq_5.q: Why does processing large images stop?
faq_5.a: Due to browser and device canvas/memory limits. Please reduce the output size or the number of files.

faq_6.q: Can I save at an exact pixel size?
faq_6.a: Yes. Set the pixel size in the size panel, then save.

faq_7.q: Does this screen open the size panel directly?
faq_7.a: Yes. It opens in the resize starting state.

faq_8.q: Can I mosaic only a selected area?
faq_8.a: Yes. Select the area to cover and apply the mosaic effect.

faq_9.q: Does this screen open the effect panel directly?
faq_9.a: Yes. It opens in the mosaic starting state.

faq_10.q: Can I place text directly on the picture?
faq_10.a: Yes. Add the text in the text panel and save.

faq_11.q: Is anything inserted automatically on open?

new_faq_12.q: Does making a small photo bigger make it clearer?
new_faq_12.a: Simply increasing the pixel size does not restore details that weren't in the original. Check the text and edges after enlarging.

new_faq_13.q: Is all personal information safe just by applying a mosaic?
new_faq_13.a: You must manually verify the intensity of the effect and the covered area. If your goal is to clearly obscure text in a document, consider the Personal Information Redaction tool and its result verification procedure.

/tools/image-studio/resize.title: How do I reduce pixel size without distorting the photo's aspect ratio?
paragraphs: Reducing the pixel dimensions of a photo you want to send is different from changing the canvas around the photo. Choose the size option that fits your purpose and check the results to ensure the aspect ratio is maintained. If file size is important, check both the dimensions and the save format.

/tools/image-studio/mosaic.title: Do I have to manually select the areas to be mosaiced?
paragraphs: Manually select the area to obscure and zoom in on the result to verify. If the effect is weak or only part of the text is selected, the content might still be recognizable. Also, check if the same information remains in other parts of the image.

/tools/image-studio/watermark.title: How do I add my name or source text to a photo?
paragraphs: Use this to add source or author credits to photos. Ensure the text is readable on both bright and dark backgrounds, and that it doesn't cover important subjects. If applying to multiple images, it is best to check horizontal and vertical photos separately.

blocks.title: Adding files and group outputs
paragraphs: Open the file picker or drop files repeatedly to append videos. Arrange them in up to 10 groups; each group can export individually or concatenate selected ranges. Results appear as they finish, and ZIP creation is optional. MP3 and AAC results can be sent directly to Audio Studio in a new tab.

blocks.title: Passthrough and trim accuracy
paragraphs: Passthrough is fast and lossless because it avoids re-encoding. The first audio track can be copied, removed, or converted. Incompatible source audio reports an error rather than changing quality silently. Trim starts may move to a nearby keyframe, and videos with different codecs or dimensions cannot be concatenated without re-encoding.

blocks.title: Bitrate and sample rate
paragraphs: Bitrate is data stored per second; higher values generally increase quality and file size. Sample rate is how often audio is sampled per second. Choose a preset or enter a custom value.

blocks.title: Synchronized playback and split fullscreen
paragraphs: Play videos in a group together and move them with one playhead. Split fullscreen lets you compare the group on one screen while listening to one selected video. Start and end ranges from one group can be applied at once to videos in the same card positions in other groups.

blocks.title: Large sources and output limits
paragraphs: Large source videos are not copied into memory all at once. Completed results and ZIP files are kept as temporary files in supported browsers, with the existing memory path used automatically when that is unavailable. Oversized passthrough estimates are reported before processing.

blocks.title: Input compatibility
paragraphs: MP4, MOV, and WebM usually preview in current browsers. If MKV or AVI preview fails, the tool separately reads duration and dimensions for numeric trimming, but not every internal compression format is guaranteed.

blocks.title: Using multiple CPU cores
paragraphs: Supported browsers process videos with multiple CPU cores. When this is unavailable, the tool automatically uses a functionally equivalent single-thread compatibility mode.

faq_0.q: Can I save a video section as MP4?
faq_0.a: Yes. Select the section, then check the MP4 output.

faq_1.q: Are merge settings mixed in?
faq_1.a: No. It opens in the trim starting state.

faq_2.q: Can I join several videos into one?
faq_2.a: Yes. Join them in group order and save one MP4.

faq_3.a: No. It opens in the merge starting state.

faq_4.q: Can I save only the sound as MP3?
faq_4.a: Yes. It opens in the audio-extraction starting state with section guidance.

faq_5.q: Is the video picture saved together?
faq_5.a: No. Only the sound is saved as MP3.

faq_6.q: Can I apply one group's video ranges to other groups?
faq_6.a: Yes. Choose the target groups to copy start and end times between videos in the same card positions. If a target ends before the copied end time, its end point is set to the end of that video; if it also ends before the copied start time, it is left unchanged.

faq_7.question: Is remaining time for the whole job?
faq_7.answer: It is recalculated from the recent speed of the current video and encoding stage. A new input or final concat stage starts a fresh estimate.
faq_7.q: Is remaining time for the whole job?
faq_7.a: It is recalculated from the recent speed of the current video and encoding stage. A new input or final concat stage starts a fresh estimate.

faq_8.question: Do MKV and AVI always work?
faq_8.answer: No. When a browser cannot preview a file, the tool can often read its duration and dimensions separately, but unsupported compression combinations are not guaranteed.
faq_8.q: Do MKV and AVI always work?
faq_8.a: No. When a browser cannot preview a file, the tool can often read its duration and dimensions separately, but unsupported compression combinations are not guaranteed.

video.page.title: Browser Video Processing Guide
video.page.description: Video files are processed within this browser without being uploaded to an external conversion server.

/tools/video-studio/trim.title: Can quick copy change the exact starting point of the trimmed video?
paragraphs: Set the start and end times for the segment you want to keep, and play it to verify. Since speech might be cut off or an important first scene might be missed, be sure to also check the start and end of the actual saved result. Fast original copying might slightly shift the start point depending on the reference playback scene.

/tools/video-studio/merge.title: What should I check when merging videos with different resolutions or aspect ratios?
paragraphs: Ensure the order of the cards and groups matches your desired output sequence. Files with different sizes, aspect ratios, or audio configurations may require a re-conversion method. After saving, verify that the sound and video transition smoothly at each connection point.

/tools/video-studio/extract-audio.title: How do I save the audio from only a specific section of a video?
paragraphs: You can select the required section and save only the audio. The result will not include the video portion. For videos with multiple audio tracks, check the track information currently being processed, and listen to the saved file to ensure it contains the desired language and sound.

excelCompare.title: Excel Compare Usage Guide
excelCompare.description: Pairs two Excel files to find changed contents or mismatched items.

blocks.title: Use Cases
items: Comparing data before and after revisions
Matching two lists by employee ID or order number
Checking transactions where amounts, dates, and vendors match.

blocks.title: What to Prepare
paragraphs: Example scenario: The left file lists 10 P-01 / 20 P-02 items, while the right lists 25 P-02 / 10 P-01. By matching based on the product code, you can accurately determine that P-01 remains unchanged and P-02's quantity has changed, even if the row order is completely different.

blocks.title: How to Use
items: Add two files to compare as a pair. To compare multiple pairs, add more file pairs.
Check the sheet to use and the row with column names in each file. If there is a title or description above, change it to the actual row containing column names.
Select a comparison method suitable for your purpose.
Run the comparison and check for changes, additions, deletions, and duplicates in the result filters.
Save necessary reports. For items that could not be linked automatically, review the original files.

blocks.title: Easy to Understand Example
paragraphs: For an employee list where the order of names has changed, it is better to compare based on unique employee IDs rather than names. A 'Key' refers to this kind of reference column used to find the same target.

blocks.title: Can I compare files using Employee ID even if the row order is different?
paragraphs: Compare similar tables before and after revisions by matching rows and columns. For lists with different orders, use a reference item like an employee ID or product code that can identify the same target. To verify transactions with matching amounts, dates, and clients, use the transaction matching feature.

Changes in the results indicate that the values of connected items are different. Duplicate or ambiguously connected items are not definitively incorrect data; they simply mean it's difficult to uniquely identify the same target. For such items, check the original and secondary criteria together.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: Example data: Left has 10 P-01 / 20 P-02, Right has 25 P-02 / 10 P-01. By linking based on the product code, even with a different order, you can easily verify that P-01 has the same quantity and P-02 has changed.

faq_0.q: Which comparison method should I choose?
faq_0.a: To check pre/post revisions of similar tables, select Row/Column Matching. To find the same targets in lists with different orders, select Key Column Comparison. To match transaction amounts and dates, select Transaction Matching.

faq_1.q: Which Excel formats can I compare?
faq_1.a: You can compare XLSX, XLSM, XLS, XLSB, SpreadsheetML XLS and CSV files. XLS and XLSB support values and formulas, but formatting differences are excluded.

faq_2.q: What if the selected header suggestion is not the actual column-name row?
faq_2.a: Choose the actual column-name row in each file's header-row field. Comparison starts after that row. A table without headers needs a column-name row added at the top.

faq_3.q: Are comparison files uploaded to a server?
faq_3.a: No. Reading, comparison and report generation happen in the current browser, and file contents are not sent to a server.

faq_4.q: Can I compare multiple file pairs at once?
faq_4.a: Yes. Each pair can use its own sheets and matching rules. Every successful pair gets a nine-sheet XLSX report, and two or more successful pairs also get a ZIP.

faq_5.q: How are multiple rows with the same key shown?
faq_5.a: Each duplicate key counts as one result row with independent lists of its left and right source rows. Items on the same line are not matched automatically.

new_faq_6.q: Can I use names as the reference item?
new_faq_6.a: If the same name can appear multiple times, first look for values that can uniquely identify the item, such as employee IDs or order numbers. Also, review duplicate lists for results connected only by name.

new_faq_7.q: What if there are far more changed items than expected?
new_faq_7.a: First, check if the sheets and column header rows to be compared match, and whether the display format or spacing of dates and numbers differ. Manually compare a few rows of the original before drastically changing the tolerance.

excelCleaner.title: Excel Data Cleaner Usage Guide
excelCleaner.description: Applies necessary cleaning rules in order to Excel data and creates a new file and processing report.

blocks.title: Use Cases
items: Formatting or fixing spaces in lists received from outside
Cleaning up unnecessary rows and columns
Performing repetitive data cleanup in the same order.

blocks.title: How to Use
items: Add a file and select the sheet to clean and the row with column names.
Add necessary rules. It is good to start with one rule to check the result first.
Rules run from top to bottom. Check the order and settings of each rule.
Review information about formulas, merged cells, and output formats, then run.
Check the cleaned data as well as the change summary, errors, and excluded rows.

blocks.title: Example
paragraphs: If data looks different due to leading/trailing spaces like `Seoul` and ` Seoul `, apply Space Cleanup first, and then decide whether to apply Duplicate Cleanup. The result may vary depending on the rule order.

blocks.title: Should I remove spaces or duplicates first?
paragraphs: The same name doesn't always mean the same person, and the same product name with a different order number could be a different transaction. Decide which columns will be used as criteria for identical data before applying duplicate cleanup or row deletion.

Try applying just one rule with a minor change first, like whitespace cleanup. Since rules are executed from top to bottom, the result of cleaning up whitespace followed by removing duplicates can differ from the reverse order. Check not only the result file but also the changed or excluded items in the processing report.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: Whitespace cleanup can make "Seoul " and "Seoul" the same value. Product codes such as "0012" and "12" may be intentionally different, so review identifier columns before applying number conversion.

faq_0.q: Which rule should I pick first?
faq_0.a: Pick one problem you want to solve. For example, if spacing is an issue, apply Space Cleanup first, and then add rules for duplicates or row deletion.

faq_1.q: Can I clean an Excel file that contains formulas?
faq_1.a: Same-sheet ordinary A1 references in XLSX and XLSM are updated for row deletion and column deletion, insertion, and reordering. Other formulas require complete stored results and confirmation before becoming values.

faq_2.q: How do original-text and safe CSV modes differ?
faq_2.a: Original-text mode preserves values and warns about risky leading characters; it is not represented as safe. Safe mode prefixes affected values with an apostrophe.

faq_3.q: Are files or results sent to a server?
faq_3.a: No. Reading files, applying rules, and creating XLSX, CSV, and ZIP results happen in the current browser without modifying originals.

new_faq_4.q: I want to keep the leading zeros in the codes.
new_faq_4.a: Distinguish between numbers for calculation and employee IDs, product codes, or phone numbers. Check the relevant column before applying number conversion, and verify a sample of the result to see if the leading zeros remain.

new_faq_5.q: The number of rows in the cleaned file decreased.
new_faq_5.a: Check the selected rules, such as delete empty rows, remove duplicates, or filters. Don't just compare the row counts of the original and the result; also look at the reasons for exclusion in the processing report.

documentRedactor.title: Document Redactor Usage Guide
documentRedactor.description: Creates a new file by manually selecting and blacking out parts like names, phone numbers, and addresses in PDFs or images.

blocks.title: Use Cases
items: Obscuring some information before sending evidence externally
Redacting contacts or account numbers in receipts or contracts
Covering text that shouldn't be revealed in captures.

blocks.title: How to Use
items: Add a file and select the document and pages to redact.
Press 'Add Area' to create a black rectangle. Adjust its position and size so no text is left. Move to the next page and check all necessary parts.
Check the 'Pages without redacted marks' list. No marks does not mean it is automatically determined to be safe.
Read about the output resolution and what changes upon output, check the confirmation items, and press 'Create Redacted File'.
Check 'View Results' and re-open the downloaded file to verify all pages. Share the resulting file, not the original.

blocks.title: Good to Know
paragraphs: This tool does not automatically find personal information. The user must manually select the areas to redact. Information may remain in the file name or unredacted pages.

blocks.title: What should I double-check before sharing the redacted file?
paragraphs: This tool does not automatically find personal information for you. Manually check if the same contact details or names are repeated on other pages, tables, or headers. A page without redaction marks is not guaranteed to be safe.

Once the result is generated, all pages of the PDF are re-saved as images. Search, text selection, existing signatures, form fields, and links will not be maintained, so ensure this method fits your submission purpose first. When sharing, choose the new result file, not the original, and ensure the file name does not contain sensitive information.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: Document review precaution: Redacting personal information (e.g., contact details) on a specific page does not automatically remove the same information from signature blocks or other sections. Check the entire document and manually designate all areas to be redacted.

faq_0.q: Does it automatically detect and redact personal information like ID or phone numbers?
faq_0.a: No. You must review the pages yourself and specify the areas to redact. Unmarked areas will remain visible in the result.

faq_1.q: Is the original file modified?
faq_1.a: The original file is not modified and remains safely on your device. Please ensure you share the newly saved result.

faq_2.q: Are unredacted pages also converted to images?
faq_2.a: Yes. To ensure the entire document is securely processed, all pages are recreated as an image-based PDF.

faq_3.q: Are search and links retained in the document?
faq_3.a: Because the document is converted to images, text search, selection, copying, existing links, signatures, forms, and metadata are not retained.

faq_4.q: What is the resolution of the output?
faq_4.a: The document is converted according to the quality option you select (Standard or High Quality).

faq_5.a: Password-protected or encrypted PDFs are not supported. Please use an unprotected copy.

faq_6.q: What happens if I cancel or if it fails?
faq_6.a: If the operation is interrupted, the files are immediately discarded and never leave your device.

faq_7.q: What should I check in the final result?
faq_7.a: Please review all pages, ensure text edges are fully redacted, and check that the filename does not contain personal information.

faq_8.a: No. Select every area yourself. Private details outside those areas may remain, so review the output.

faq_9.q: Does the PDF keep text and signatures?
faq_9.a: Every page is rasterized. Searchable and selectable text, digital signatures, forms and links are not preserved. The original file is unchanged.

faq_10.q: How do resolution and file size change?
faq_10.a: PDF output uses the selected resolution and may be larger than the original. Processing stops at memory limits. Image output is PNG.

new_faq_11.q: How is it different from removing hidden info in photos?
new_faq_11.a: Personal Info Redaction allows you to select and obscure visible parts of documents or images. Removing photo metadata deals with information like shooting location and device stored inside the file. Choose the tool that fits your purpose.

new_faq_12.q: What should I check before sharing?
new_faq_12.a: Check if it is the new result file, if all pages have been reviewed, if no text remains around the edges of the black marks, and if the file name is free of personal information.

faq_0.q: What happens if there are blanks?
faq_0.a: If the value in a linked column is empty, that space may become empty content. If the required column itself is not linked, that's a different issue and the connection must be fixed. Make sure required values are not missing in the sample. Completely blank rows are excluded from generation.

faq_1.q: Does this feature automatically send emails?
faq_1.a: No. It is a feature for creating document files. It's known as 'Mail Merge', but it does not send emails.

faq_2.a: Use a standard DOCX with simple {name} variables and no loops or conditions. DOCM, encrypted documents and image insertion tags are unsupported.

faq_3.a: Only calculation results saved in the spreadsheet are used. Rows with missing cached results or real cell errors fail.

faq_4.q: Are files or results sent to a server?
faq_4.a: No. Template inspection, table reading and DOCX, ZIP and report generation happen in the current browser.

new_faq_5.q: The Excel column name is Customer Name and the template says {Name}.
new_faq_5.a: Connect the Customer Name column to the Name field in the template. In the connection name input field, specify the name without curly braces. Check the sample after accurately mapping the template and columns.

new_faq_6.q: If the preview table is correct, can I generate all the documents right away?
new_faq_6.a: The preview table is a step to confirm the values to be inserted. Open the sample DOCX in your actual document program to check line breaks, tables, dates, amounts, and file names before generating everything.

new_faq_7.q: Is an empty value the same as having no mapped field?
new_faq_7.a: No. An empty value in a mapped column can result in blank content, but not mapping a required column is an issue that must be fixed. Check the sample to ensure no required values are missing.

documentGenerator.title: Word Batch Generator Usage Guide
documentGenerator.description: Insert a Word template and an Excel list to generate documents per person or per item at once.

blocks.title: Use Cases
items: Creating training guides per employee
Generating confirmation documents for each customer
Creating multiple documents where only name, department, and date change in the same template.

blocks.title: How to Use
items: Link Excel columns with template items. If you wrote `{Name}` in the template, link it to the column containing name data.
Set the file name and check one document first. Specify file naming rules, verify them, and run 'Create 1 Document First'.
Generate all documents and save the results.

blocks.title: What This Tool Does
paragraphs: It is not an AI tool that writes new text. It inserts Excel values into the changeable parts of a pre-made Word template.

blocks.title: How do I create multiple Word documents with different names using an Excel list?
paragraphs: If you find yourself copying the same notice and changing the name and department every time, try marking the placeholders in a Word template and connecting an Excel list. This tool creates DOCX files by filling the template with list values without you having to rewrite text or send emails.

In the Word template, write a pair of curly braces where the values should go, like {Name} for the name and {Department} for the department. In the first row of Excel, write column names like Name and Department, and input the data from the second row onwards. After selecting the files, map each column to a template field, and generate one document first to check the layout, numbers, and dates.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: Word Template:
Hello, {Name}.
Department: {Department}
Please check the training schedule.
Excel List:
Name
Department
Min-su Kim
Sales Team
Seo-yeon Lee
Operations Team

For example, if you set the file naming rule to {Name}_Notice.docx, files will be created individually like 'Min-su Kim_Notice.docx' and 'Seo-yeon Lee_Notice.docx'. Try generating one document as a test to see if you get the desired output.

pdfCompare.title: PDF comparison guide
pdfCompare.description: Place before and after PDFs in pairs, then inspect visual and extracted-text differences page by page.

blocks.title: Notice
paragraphs: Comparison is performed within the browser.

blocks.title: If a cover page is added to the revised version, which pages should I compare?
paragraphs: A PDF's text information and the visual appearance of its pages can differ. Text comparison checks the differences in the extracted text from the PDF, while visual comparison checks the differences in how the pages are drawn. Since scanned documents like photos might not have extractable text, do not assume the content is the same based solely on text results.

First, ensure that pages containing the same content are linked. If a cover page was added to the revision, subsequent pages might be shifted by one. Match the pages, run the comparison again, and review the locations of changed numbers, dates, signatures, and tables alongside the original text.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: If a revision adds a cover, the first body page may need to be matched with page 2 instead of page 1. When document structures differ, use manual page matching and verify that each pair contains corresponding content before comparing.

faq_0.q: Can this find every difference in a PDF?
faq_0.a: Visual results compare pixels under the same PDF render settings, while text results follow the PDF's stored extraction order. Review both; the tool does not determine document equivalence.

faq_1.q: What happens when pages are inserted or reordered?
faq_1.a: Pages initially match by physical page number. Review added or deleted pages, then optionally assign each page at most once in manual mapping and compare again.

faq_2.q: Are PDF files uploaded to a server?
faq_2.a: No. Opening PDFs, rendering pages, extracting text, and creating reports happen in the current browser without modifying the source files.

new_faq_3.q: If the text result from a scanned PDF is empty, does it mean there is no content?
new_faq_3.a: No. If the text shapes are embedded in an image, there might be no text for the PDF to extract. Check the visual comparison, and if you need searchable text, use the PDF OCR tool separately.

new_faq_4.q: What should I check first if all pages look different?
new_faq_4.a: First, check if the comparison pages are out of sync due to added covers, deleted pages, or order changes. If differences persist after matching the pages, check the size, orientation, and actual body text.

officeEditor.title: Browser office editor guide
officeEditor.description: This large editor runs LibreOffice in your browser.

blocks.title: How do I save the final file after editing the document?
paragraphs: Drop or choose one supported file to move to the focused workspace, prepare the editor, and open the document automatically.

blocks.title: First download
paragraphs: The first start downloads about 33 MB, including a Korean fallback font. A byte-based progress bar and current step are shown, and the files are cached for later visits.

blocks.title: Closing editor
paragraphs: Pressing the 'Close' button destroys the editing view and the virtual filesystem instance safely, returning you to this menu.

blocks.title: You can select a file even before preparation is complete
paragraphs: When you open the page, the browser prepares the Office editing environment. Initially, it may take some time to download the program and fonts, but from the next launch, you can reuse the saved program files. While checking the progress guide, select or drop the file you want to edit.

Once ready, the selected document will open. While editing the document, use the editor's menus and save tools instead of the site's search bar. When finished, please receive the result file via Save & Download. Reopen the downloaded file to verify fonts, pagination, and formula results before sharing.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: You can select a file while the editing environment is preparing, but wait until preparation is complete before opening it. Follow the current opening and download status, then reopen the saved file to verify the result.

faq_0.q: Why is the first start large?
faq_0.a: A browser build of the office suite and its fonts and resources must be stored locally. Later starts can reuse the cache.

faq_1.q: Does dropping a file open it automatically?
faq_1.a: Yes. Dropping one supported file moves to the focused workspace, prepares the editor and opens the document in one flow.

faq_2.q: Does it include a Korean font?
faq_2.a: A Korean fallback font is included, though documents requiring proprietary fonts can have different spacing or line breaks.

faq_3.q: Is this an official Microsoft Office web app?
faq_3.a: No. It is a LibreOffice-based browser editor and compatibility can differ from Microsoft Office.

faq_4.a: Use the dedicated HWP editor for HWP/HWPX files. This editor focuses on Writer, Calc, and Impress formats.

new_faq_5.q: Will I have to download the program files again next time?
new_faq_5.a: You can reuse them if the necessary program files remain in your browser. If you clear site data or use a different device/browser, it may need to be prepared again.

new_faq_6.q: Is the result exactly the same as Word, Excel, or PowerPoint?
new_faq_6.a: Since it is a LibreOffice-based editing environment, there may be differences in fonts, line breaks, and advanced features. Always verify important results in your original program as well.

new_faq_7.q: How do I know if saving is complete?
new_faq_7.a: Along with the completion notice, check whether the browser actually downloaded the result file. Just seeing the document on the screen does not mean the file save process is finished.

/tools/office-editor/app/.title: Brief guide on preparation, file queuing, and save status
paragraphs: The editing environment is being prepared. If you select a file in advance, it will open once preparation is complete. After preparation, drop or select the file you want to edit. When finished, click Save & Download, and verify that the actual result file has been saved.

pdfEditor.standard.description: Selected files stay in this browser's memory and are not uploaded to a processing server. Keep your originals and review every downloaded result.

blocks.title: Page-level editing
paragraphs: Drag previews to reorder pages and remove unwanted pages. For PDFs by range, choose a range in the output workspace on the right and use page checkboxes, or quickly split the document between pages.
If a source page is already rotated, your rotation is added to its existing orientation so the exported page matches the preview.

blocks.title: Local processing and file lifetime
paragraphs: PDFs, images, and download links live in browser memory. Refreshing or closing the tab clears the current selection and any undownloaded result.
The site, advertising, and OCR model assets may use ordinary network requests, but your work files are not sent to a conversion server.

blocks.title: Protected PDFs and signatures
paragraphs: Password-protected PDFs are not supported. Use a legitimately unlocked copy provided by the document owner.
Merging, rotating, splitting, or rebuilding a PDF invalidates existing digital signatures. Forms, bookmarks, links, attachments, and advanced objects may not survive page copying.

blocks.title: Quality and performance
paragraphs: Reordering and extracting pages normally copies original PDF pages rather than rasterizing them. Image conversion and searchable OCR PDFs render pages at the selected resolution.
More pages and higher resolution increase processing time, memory use, and output size. Previews render lazily at lower resolution to keep long documents responsive.

blocks.title: What is the difference between editing text in a document and organizing pages?
paragraphs: Use page editing to merge submission files into one or keep only the necessary pages. This is not for rewriting text content, but for organizing the sequence, structure, and orientation of pages.

Choose PDF to Image to use pages like photos, or Image to PDF to bind multiple photos into one document. Use Document Conversion to bring PDF text into an editable document, or OCR to add searchable text to scanned documents. Always compare the result with the original text after conversion.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: Common task examples: Try "Combine 3 submission documents into one" → Merge feature, "Save only pages 2-4 of a contract" → Split/Extract feature, "Convert entire pages to PNG" → Image conversion, "Search words in a scanned document" → OCR feature.
