faq_2.q: Can page numbers be added only to selected pages?
faq_2.a: Yes. Use a page range and parity filter, or choose the exact physical pages with the thumbnail checkboxes.

faq_3.q: Can I add Korean headers and dates?
faq_3.a: Yes. Text can include Korean plus filename and date tokens. The full Noto font is embedded when the content requires it.

faq_4.q: Can numbering start at 1 on page 2 after a cover?
faq_4.a: Yes. Enable cover exclusion and set the starting page and number. Numbering still follows the physical page order across skipped pages.

faq_5.q: What can I put in a header or footer?
faq_5.a: Combine custom text with tokens for the page number, total pages, filename, and the date captured when the batch starts.

faq_6.a: Yes. The full Noto font is embedded when Korean is present, and the result warns that this can increase the file size.

faq_7.q: Can I add both text and image watermarks to a PDF?
faq_7.a: Yes. Choose text or a PNG or JPEG image, then place it once or repeat it across each selected page.

faq_8.q: Can a watermark appear behind the document content?
faq_8.a: Yes. Choose a background or foreground layer. Complex layers, tags, or graphics state trigger a warning and require confirmation before continuing.

faq_9.q: Can I place a stamp or signature image in the same position on multiple pages?
faq_9.a: Yes. Move and resize a PNG or JPEG image in the preview, then place it at the same relative position on every selected page.

faq_10.q: Does this create an electronic or cryptographic digital signature?
faq_10.a: No. This feature only inserts a stamp or signature image into the PDF. It does not create a certificate-based electronic or cryptographic digital signature.

faq_11.q: Can I combine multiple PDFs in order?
faq_11.a: Yes. Arrange the files in order, merge them into one PDF, then download it from the output area.

faq_12.q: Are merged files uploaded to a server?
faq_12.a: No. Merging and saving happen in the current browser.

faq_13.q: Can I cut a PDF into the sections I want?
faq_13.a: Yes. Mark split positions, cut the file by ranges, and save only the sections you need.

faq_14.q: Is the range empty when I first open it?
faq_14.a: No. One initial range covering every page is already present.

faq_15.q: Can I remove only the pages I choose?
faq_15.a: Yes. Select the pages to delete and save the rest as one PDF.

faq_16.q: Does anything get deleted automatically on open?
faq_16.a: No. It starts with first-page delete guidance and deletes nothing automatically.

faq_17.q: Can I rotate only some pages?
faq_17.a: Yes. Choose the pages to rotate, correct their orientation, then save.

faq_18.q: Does anything rotate automatically on open?
faq_18.a: No. It starts with first-page rotate guidance and rotates nothing automatically.

new_faq_0.q: Can I edit the PDF body text directly in page editing?
new_faq_0.a: This screen handles page sequencing, deletion, rotation, extraction, and finishing marks. To rewrite the body text, you must edit the conversion result or the original document file in a separate editor.

new_faq_1.q: Are Image Conversion and OCR the same feature?
new_faq_1.a: Image Conversion saves the visible appearance of pages as PNG or JPG, while OCR reads the shapes of text in an image to treat them as text data. We do not advise using OCR to restore text that disappeared during conversion.

/tools/pdf-editor/merge.title: How do I merge application forms and attachments in a specific order?
paragraphs: Add applications, supporting documents, and guides in the order of submission. Check not only the file sequence but also the page order and orientation of each file before saving as a single PDF. Once multiple documents are merged, advanced features like bookmarks, form fields, and links may not be identical to the originals, so be sure to double-check the results.

/tools/pdf-editor/split.title: Is splitting pages different from cropping margins?
paragraphs: If you only need pages 2-4 from a file, select that range; for non-consecutive pages like 1 and 5, select the required pages manually. When creating multiple ranges, ensure the output file names and page structures for each range are as desired.

/tools/pdf-editor/delete.title: What if I only want to redact personal info instead of deleting the whole page?
paragraphs: Use page deletion to remove unnecessary pages from a document. If you only want to hide a name or contact information on a single page, use the personal information redaction tool instead. Confirm the pages to be deleted and check the order of the remaining pages.

/tools/pdf-editor/rotate.title: Can I save the on-screen rotation directly to the output PDF?
paragraphs: Select horizontally scanned pages and rotate them to a readable orientation. If only some pages have a different orientation, select just those pages. Reopen the saved PDF to verify that the rotation was applied correctly.

/tools/pdf-editor/image-to-pdf.title: How can I fit multiple photos sequentially into an A4 size PDF?
paragraphs: Add photos in the order they should be read, then choose whether to fit them to A4 size or use the original image dimensions. If vertical and horizontal photos are mixed, check the orientation and margins. Simply combining photos into a PDF does not make the text in the photos searchable.

/tools/pdf-editor/pdf-to-image.title: Should I save the images as PNG or JPG?
paragraphs: Use this when you want to save document pages as PNG or JPG for attachments or image editing. Increasing the resolution can make small text easier to read, but it does not restore details that were absent in the original, and it increases the file size and memory usage. Try converting just the necessary pages first to check the size and clarity.

/tools/pdf-editor/convert.title: Will tables and line breaks be preserved when converting PDF to Word?
paragraphs: Consider DOCX for text-focused re-editing, XLSX for tweaking tables, or TXT if you only need unformatted text. Since PDF paragraphs and cells are estimated by coordinates, complex tables or multi-column documents may have a different structure than the original. Always double-check dates, amounts, and table rows and columns against the original text.

/tools/pdf-editor/finish.title: Can I apply both page numbers and watermarks to multiple PDFs at the same time?
paragraphs: You can apply page numbers, headers, watermarks, and stamps simultaneously. Check one page first to ensure the positions of each mark do not overlap or cover the main text. When processing multiple files, be aware that page sizes and orientations may vary between files.

/tools/pdf-editor/page-numbers.title: How do I skip the cover and start numbering from page 1 on the main content?
paragraphs: If the first page of the PDF is a cover, the file's page number and the printed body number may differ. Verify the starting page for the marks and the starting value for the numbers separately. For long documents, check the numbers on the first, middle, and last pages before saving.

/tools/pdf-editor/header-footer.title: How do I place the filename and date in the exact same spot on every PDF?
paragraphs: You can insert repeating content such as document names, dates, and page numbers. Check the preview to ensure the text does not overlap with the main body or existing page numbers. For marks that insert automatic values, use only the formats provided on the screen.

/tools/pdf-editor/watermark.title: How do I add a 'Confidential' mark without covering the main text?
paragraphs: Use this to add marks indicating the document's purpose, such as 'For Review' or 'Internal Sharing'. Check the opacity, rotation, position, and applied pages, and ensure it does not make tables or small text hard to read. A watermark is not an access restriction or anti-copy feature.

/tools/pdf-editor/stamp.title: Does adding a stamp image make it a certified digital signature?
paragraphs: Place a prepared PNG or JPG stamp or signature image in the desired location. Check the image's margins, size, orientation, and the actual page where it will be applied. Since this is simply overlaying an image, do not use it as a cryptographic electronic signature to verify the signer's identity or document integrity.

blocks.title: Text PDFs and scanned PDFs
paragraphs: Text PDFs contain selectable characters, so extraction is fast and accurate. Scanned PDFs store each page like a photo and require OCR.
Automatic OCR runs Korean and English recognition only on pages with little usable embedded text. A drawing or photo with no text may correctly produce an empty result.

blocks.title: DOCX and XLSX conversion limits
paragraphs: PDFs often preserve positions rather than the original paragraphs, tables, and cells. DOCX reconstructs lines as paragraphs, while XLSX estimates cells from spacing.
Complex tables, columns, vertical text, footnotes, formulas, fonts, and formatting may not be reproduced exactly. Treat the output as an editable draft and compare it with the source.

blocks.title: OCR data and privacy
paragraphs: Korean and English OCR and its language data are served from the same GitHub Pages deployment. No external OCR server or CDN receives your document pages.
OCR cannot start on a first offline visit or when the required OCR data is not cached. Reopen the site online after clearing storage, using private browsing, or running low on browser storage.

blocks.title: Large documents
paragraphs: OCR renders and recognizes pages one at a time, so it takes longer than embedded-text extraction. For 50+ pages, close heavy tabs and keep enough memory and power available.
Mobile operating systems may close memory-intensive tabs, so long documents are generally more reliable on a desktop browser.

hwpEditor.title: 09. Edit Hangul Document
hwpEditor.description: Load the official rhwp Studio editor in your browser to modify HWP documents without transmitting files externally.

blocks.title: Keep the original and double-check the saved file
paragraphs: You can use this to quickly open a Hangul document and edit sentences or tables. Edit text, tables, and formatting within the supported range of the browser editor, and save a new file.

The fonts or complex objects used in the original document may be displayed differently. For documents to be submitted, reopen the saved file in the actual program you will use to check page counts, line breaks, table clipping, and image placements. It is best to keep important originals separately without overwriting them.

blocks.title: Examples and Selection Help
paragraphs: Four items to check before submission: 1. Changes in the total page count, 2. Where tables break across pages, 3. Line breaks affected by unsupported substitute fonts, 4. Whether the final saved file format matches your requirements.

new_faq_0.q: How is it different from the Office Editor?

new_faq_1.q: If it looks good on the screen, can I submit it right away?
new_faq_1.a: Reopen and check the saved file. The line breaks and page layouts you saw in the browser might differ from those in the final program you use.
